title: 「Insofar as 句：限制範圍、程度或適用條件」
titleZh: 「Insofar as 句：限制範圍、程度或適用條件」
titleEn: Using insofar as to limit scope, degree or applicability

source.file: Sentence Structure 128 -「Insofar as 句：限制範圍、程度或適用條件」.pdf

formula: Insofar as + subject + verb, + main clause

formulas.formula: Insofar as + subject + verb, + main clause
Main clause + insofar as + subject + verb

example: The proposal is acceptable insofar as it meets the school’s safety requirements.
exampleZh: 這份建議只有在符合學校安全要求的範圍內，才可以接受。

examples.en: The proposal is acceptable insofar as it meets the school’s safety requirements.
examples.zh: 這份建議只有在符合學校安全要求的範圍內，才可以接受。
examples.highlight: insofar as it meets the school’s safety requirements

rules.zh: Insofar as 的核心意思是「在……範圍或程度內」 使用 insofar as 時，說話者通常不是完全肯定整件事情，而是指出主句只在某個範圍內成立。 這句並不是說整個計劃在所有方面都成功。
rules.en: Insofar as means ‘within a stated scope or degree’. It usually limits the main statement rather than affirming the whole matter without qualification; the example says that the plan succeeds in one respect, not in every respect.
examples: The plan is successful insofar as it reduces waiting time.

rules.zh: Insofar as 可以放在句首或句中 句首： 句首的從句後通常使用逗號。 句中：
rules.en: An insofar as-clause may come first or later in the sentence. An initial clause is normally followed by a comma.
examples: Insofar as I know, the office is closed today.
The policy is useful insofar as it protects children.

rules.zh: Insofar as 常用於較正式的語境 這個句型常見於： ● 作文及學術討論； ● 報告及分析； ● 商業政策； ● 法律或行政文件； ● 正式會議及評論。 在日常會話中，as far as、only if 或 provided that 通常較常見。 例如，Insofar as I know 文法上可以成立，但日常英文通常較常說：
rules.en: Insofar as is common in formal contexts, including essays and academic discussions, reports and analysis, business policies, legal or administrative documents, formal meetings and commentary. In everyday conversation, as far as, only if or provided that is usually more common; for example, As far as I know is more usual in daily English than Insofar as I know.

rules.zh: Insofar as 與 As long as 的分別 As long as 通常提出一項普通而充分的條件。只要條件成立，主句結果便可以成立。 Insofar as 則通常限制一項判斷、權利、同意或有效性的範圍。 因此，insofar as 比 as long as 更強調「只限於這個程度或方面」，而不是單純表示「只要」。
rules.en: Insofar as limits scope, whereas as long as normally states an ordinary sufficient condition under which the main-clause result can hold. Insofar as restricts the extent of a judgement, right, agreement or validity and therefore emphasizes ‘only to this degree or in this respect’, not merely ‘provided that’.
examples: You may stay here as long as you remain quiet.
The rule is acceptable insofar as it protects public safety.

rules.zh: Insofar as 與 So long as 的分別 表示條件時，so long as 和 as long as 的意思幾乎相同。 So long as 有時比 as long as 稍有強調意味，但兩者都是一般條件句。 Insofar as 則較正式，並且主要限制： ● 一項說法的準確程度； ● 一項規則的適用範圍； ● 一項計劃的有效程度； ● 說話者同意某件事的程度。
rules.en: Insofar as and so long as serve different functions. For conditions, so long as and as long as are almost identical, though so long as may sound slightly more emphatic. Insofar as is more formal and principally limits the accuracy of a statement, the scope of a rule, the effectiveness of a plan or the degree to which a speaker agrees.
examples: So long as you practise every day, you will improve.

rules.zh: Insofar as 不表示時間長度 As long as 可以表示「長達某段時間」。 Insofar as 沒有這種時間意思，因此不能用來取代這類 as long as。
rules.en: Insofar as does not express duration. As long as can mean ‘for the greatest possible length of time’, but insofar as has no such time meaning and cannot replace it in that use.
examples: I stayed there as long as I could.

rules.zh: 本練習只使用連寫形式 本練習統一使用： 不使用較少見的分寫形式：
rules.en: Use the closed spelling insofar as in this lesson, not the less common spaced form in so far as.

benefits.zh: 幫助你準確限制說法 這個句型讓你清楚表示某項判斷只在特定範圍內成立，避免把說法講得過分絕對。
benefits.en: It limits a statement precisely by showing that a judgement holds only within a specified scope and preventing an overly absolute claim.
examples: The report is reliable insofar as the figures have been checked.

benefits.zh: 幫助你表達部分同意 你可以使用 insofar as 表示自己同意某個觀點的一部分，但並非接受整個觀點。 這比只說 “I agree” 更準確。
benefits.en: It helps express partial agreement. You can agree with one part of a view without accepting it in full, which is more precise than simply saying I agree.
examples: We agree with the article insofar as it explains the causes.

benefits.zh: 讓條件和限制更加清楚 這個句型可以把一項規則、許可或安排的限制直接連接到主句。 讀者可以立即知道這項安排並非毫無限制。
benefits.en: It makes conditions and limitations clearer by linking the limits of a rule, permission or arrangement directly to the main clause, so readers can see immediately that the arrangement is not unrestricted.
examples: Employees may work remotely insofar as their duties allow.

benefits.zh: 適合正式分析和評論 在作文、報告、簡報及商業文件中，insofar as 可以幫助你作出較審慎和有分寸的判斷。 它特別適合分析： ● 一項措施在哪些方面有效； ● 一項論點在哪些部分成立； ● 一項規則在哪些情況下適用。
benefits.en: It suits formal analysis and commentary. In essays, reports, presentations and business documents, insofar as supports cautious, measured judgements about the respects in which a measure is effective, the parts of an argument that hold, or the situations in which a rule applies.

benefits.zh: 可以縮短較長的限制說法 比較： 兩句意思相近，但第二句更集中地把「有用的程度」和「縮短輪候時間」連接起來。
benefits.en: It can shorten a longer statement of limitation. In the comparison, both versions have similar meanings, but insofar as links the degree of usefulness more directly to the reduction in waiting time.

benefits.zh: 讓論述不會過度誇大 使用 insofar as 可以提醒讀者：你提出的是有限度的結論，而不是聲稱它在所有情況下都正確。 這能令正式寫作顯得更謹慎、更準確，也更有說服力。
benefits.en: It prevents an argument from sounding exaggerated by signalling that the conclusion is limited rather than universally true, making formal writing more cautious, accurate and persuasive.
